name: support-rma-genie
description: RMA Genie: look up serials in the live Shipment Inventory Record and raise standardized OPS RMA Jira tickets for Solace appliance hardware replacements from gather-diagnostics.

inventory_path.title: Shipment Inventory Record (.xlsx)
inventory_path.description: Local path of the OneDrive-synced 'Shipment Inventory Record.xlsx'. Leave empty to auto-discover it under your OneDrive / SharePoint sync folders.

inventory_url.title: Shipment Inventory Record SharePoint URL
inventory_url.description: Fetched through your signed-in Excel when no synced copy is found. Leave empty for the Operations site's Ship Spreadsheet/Shipment Inventory Record.xlsx.

ppm_path.title: Platinum Plus Maintenance (.xlsx)
ppm_path.description: Local path of the OneDrive-synced 'PlatinumPlusMaintenance.xlsx' (same Ship Spreadsheet folder). Leave empty to auto-discover. Only read for Platinum+ customers.

buginfo_ssh_host.title: Dev server for Buginfo links (SSH)
buginfo_ssh_host.description: user@host of a Linux dev server that mounts /home/public (e.g. jwansa@dev2-185.sol-local). Used to create the buginfo/<OPS key> link when you run Claude Code on a Mac or PC. Needs key login without a password prompt. Leave empty on a dev server.
